criteria.selection: Choose one finite allowance from development only; keep return-home default if quality, tail or CPU tradeoffs are weak. No oracle end-of-stream controller.
criteria.quality: same SIPP/no-joint, identical serialized scenario, fixed return-home A* offline reference
criteria.timing: raw process CPU and wall only; one observation per run; offline reference/validation/scoring excluded
criteria.holdout: separate 30..39 seeds; do not retune on their outcomes

selection.reason: 9 dev cases: wait8 6 wins/0 losses/3 ties, F +0.625506%; wait16 +0.665849% but 1 loss, more CPU; wait32 lower mean, 2 losses. Choose lower-cost consistent option; all old presets retained as ablations.
selection.quality_source_patch: Before unseen data only: validator additionally rejects complete returns postdated beyond actual end and mismatched zero-service return timestamps; reset rejects cross-profile standby. No raw policy retuning.
selection.end_stream: No hidden task-count or future release termination test. Even final unloaded vehicle spends the finite allowance then returns home.
